description: Search the places TikTok lets the brand's account tag on a post (a city, a neighbourhood, a venue): up to 20 matches, each with a locationId, the locationName and an address to tell same-named places apart. Pass the chosen locationId AND locationName to post_to_tiktok (or tiktokLocationId / tiktokLocationName on schedule_post). NEEDS THE TIKTOK ACCOUNT AUTHORIZATION on the TikTok Ads connector (see tiktok_account_status). Free.

query.description: the place to search for, up to 100 characters, e.g. "Toronto" or "Blue Bottle Coffee Oakland"

name: search_tiktok_locations
title: Find a TikTok location tag
